text:
Alice: Heads-up - after today's q4b-int4 bring-up we're seeing regressions on long-form summarization. Lower token coverage and a few hallucination cases in the same holdout prompts.
Ben: Can you drop a concrete example and the eval diff numbers?
Alice: Example pasted below (sanitized):
````
ref: "Summarize the quarterly roadmap with risks and metrics."
q4b-int4 out: "The team will ship by May, risk low"  <-- wrong assertive phrasing, dropped metrics
q6b baseline out: had bulleted metrics + caveats
````
Alice: Eval diffs: ROUGE-L -6.3, Precision of cited facts -0.18. Happening mostly on >800 token prompts.
Clara: Sounds like promptset overlap + longprompt tokenization differences could be biasing quantized weights. I can run a compact dedupe and longctx split of the prompt bank. Slack me sample sizes needed.
Emily: For the canary/regen plan we should: 1) dedupe and canonicalize paraphrases, 2) refresh golden set with 120 long prompts (80 holdouts + 40 microgolden), 3) seed a 4-labeler pass for fact-checking. ETA 3 working days.
Raj: Labeler capacity: we can allocate 6 labelers for 3 days (~1.5k checks). Do we need a special rubric for hallucination vs omission vs assertive-errors?
Alice: Yes - use the new "hallucination/assertive/counterfactual/omission" rubric (see doc link). Also include token-span anchors so we can tie errors back to tokenizer diffs.
Clara: I'm about to run the dedupe job. I'll use the new fuzzy fingerprint threshold 0.86 and split by token-length bins [0-200,200-800,800+]. Command:
````
./tools/dedupe.sh --input samplebank/latest --thresh 0.86 --bins "0,200,800" --out samplebank/compact-dedupe-1716239999
````
Clara: I'll push a CSV of candidate golden items to /shared/eng-ml/gold-refresh/1716239999.csv when done.
deploy-bot: deploy: q4b-int4-canary rolled out to canary cluster (id: can-77) at 2026-03-23T09:12:04Z
Ben: Good - once Clara has the compact set, I'll run quant-smoke (int4 kernels) against the updated golden and post a trimmed eval diff. If regressions persist we'll try kernel fallback + kv-cache warmup.
Emily: I'll take point on labeler rubric and schedule the 6-person batch starting tomorrow AM. I'll also add the microgolden seed and track by labeler id.
Raj: Can one of you post the expected CSV format for the labeling queue? I want to wire the labeler client.
Alice: Format: csv with columns [sample_id, prompt_len, bin, fingerprint, golden_flag, ref_summary]. I'll attach a tiny sample file later.
Clara: Started dedupe run - ETA ~45m. Will DM when upload complete.
Ben: Thumbs up. If anyone sees a persistent subgroup with source-domain bias (docs vs forum) call it out - we might need stratified rerun.
Emily: Noted. I'll add domain tags to the CSV and to the labeler UI.
Alice: Thanks team. Goal: refreshed compact golden + 4-label verification in 72 hours, then new canary eval. Ping me for blockers. :handshake:
